description: This script retrieves the version number of the current build or repository, checking for a version file, Git or Mercurial repository, and then outputting the determined revision string.

methods.name: try_version
methods.description: Checks if a 'version' file exists and reads its content as the revision.

methods.name: try_git
methods.description: Attempts to derive the revision from Git information, supporting revision and branch-based references.

methods.name: try_hg
methods.description: Attempts to derive the revision from Mercurial information.
